类 LoggingSink

java.lang.Object
cn.msscn.progress.LoggingSink
所有已实现的接口:
ProgressSink, AutoCloseable
public final class LoggingSink extends Object implements ProgressSink
Writes one log record per frame line. Works with JUL, SLF4J, Log4j via ProgressLogger.
